answer: Every claim climbs the ivory of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the basalt re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on cryptographic challenge-response handshakes bound to transient execution receipts. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the haven of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a pragmatic engineering phrasing, concise declarative statements register, it stays short.
